verdict.rationale: Codex documents explicit task delegation to its built-in agent, both for long-running cloud tasks ('Delegate a longer task and return when it is ready') and for sub-agent delegation within a session ('Ask Codex to delegate focused work to specialized agents, then bring their findings back into the main terminal session'), backed by detailed CLI/cloud docs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the subagent delegation flow (community evidence discusses general agent quality/UX but not this feature directly).
